content.title: The Iron Sentinel
content.description: A towering guardian forged in the fires of the Nexus — its purpose: protect the Grid at any cost.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Iron Sentinel was the first FEL original character designed for the Nexus universe.

content.title: The Drift Queen
content.description: She moves between worlds so smoothly that bystanders think she was never there — until the score changes.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Drift Queen's signature move — the Phantom Step — takes 0.3 seconds in real time.

content.title: The Voltage Sage
content.description: Ancient but electrified — this figure bridges centuries of knowledge with a single crackling gesture.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Voltage Sage stores memories as electrical impulses — each scar on their coat is a stored experience.

content.title: The Iron Sentinel
content.description: A broad-shouldered silhouette with angular plating and a single glowing visor.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Sentinel's signature silhouette is recognizable from just the shoulder-to-visor ratio alone.

content.title: The Drift Queen
content.description: A slim, mid-leap silhouette with a trailing cape — catch the crown if you can.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The cape silhouette is intentionally asymmetric — one side longer than the other.

content.title: The Grid Tower
content.description: A spire tapering to a sharp point, surrounded by floating hexagonal nodes.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Grid Tower broadcasts the Nexus signal across seven frequency bands simultaneously.

content.title: The Iron Sentinel
content.description: Progressive reveal of the Sentinel's chest plate and visor.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The chest plate design was inspired by deep-sea pressure suits.

content.title: The Voltage Sage
content.description: A slow un-blur starting from crackling hands moving outward.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Sage's hands are illustrated with 47 individual arc lines — each one intentional.

content.title: The Nexus Arena
content.description: Crowd lights and hexagonal floor tiles materialize from the blur outward.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Nexus Arena can hold 80,000 spectators in-universe — the largest venue in the FEL world.

content.title: Grid Activation Tone
content.description: The three-note chime that plays every time the Nexus Grid powers up.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Grid Activation Tone is tuned to 432 Hz — a frequency associated with calm focus.

content.title: Sentinel March
content.description: A low, rhythmic percussion loop that accompanies the Iron Sentinel's entrance.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The Sentinel March uses a 5/4 time signature to feel slightly 'off-human' in its rhythm.

content.title: Drift Queen Theme
content.description: A fast synth arpeggio that flickers between two keys — never settling.
content.license: FEL Studios Original — all rights reserved
content.did_you_know: The theme alternates between C minor and E-flat major every 2.3 seconds — mimicking her evasion pattern.
